question: Why is kāmakalā meditation declared very secret for the best practitioners?
premises: The meditation is called very secret.
It is addressed to best practitioners.
inference: The verse presents kāmakalā meditation as esoteric practice reserved for accomplished sādhakas.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of kāmakalā is not specified here.
plain_english: Thus the very secret meditation on kāmakalā is for the best practitioners.
